doc: Design §11 row 2 under Q8: two networked jobs at once have different network namespaces (each its own sidecar's); B's 127.0.0.1:3128 is B's own relay (A's fixture-only allow-list is not B's), and nothing of A's is reachable from B. Needs rootless podman 5+, the relay binary `drgnx-px-<arch>-linux-musl` next to the hub binary, and a host lane; fixtures are busybox httpd on the host's loopback (host network). Unverified until the combined pass (CI rootless Ubuntu; the Fedora 45 VM gate with `ausearch -m avc` empty).

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work/www; echo fixture-ok > $ROOT/work/www/index.html; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) (drgnx-agents-net-hosts ((packages \"fixture.drgnx.test:18080\"))) (drgnx-sandbox-proxy-pinned-addresses (("fixture.drgnx.test" . "127.0.0.1"))))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

set -e; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; podman run -d --rm --network=host --name cn-fixture-http -v $ROOT/work/www:/www:ro docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 httpd -f -p 127.0.0.1:18080 -h /www >/dev/null

argv:
fetch() { { printf 'CONNECT %s HTTP/1.1
Host: %s

' $1 $1; sleep 1; printf 'GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: %s
Connection: close

' $1; sleep 2; } | nc -w 5 127.0.0.1 3128; }; for t in 1.1.1.1:443 10.88.0.1:3128 host.containers.internal:3128; do if nc -w 2 ${t%:*} ${t##*:} </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo reached-$t; exit 1; fi; done; fetch fixture.drgnx.test:18080 | grep -q fixture-ok; echo b-ok; echo up; sleep 120

args: pids() { for c in $(podman ps -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$1); do podman inspect -f '{{.Name}} {{.State.Pid}}' $c; done; }; sp() { pids $1 | awk '/-px-/ {print $2}'; }; jp() { pids $1 | awk '!/-px-/ {print $2}'; }; ns() { podman unshare readlink /proc/$1/ns/$2 | tr -dc 0-9; }; set -e; pa=$(jp $a); pb=$(jp $b); test -n "$pa" -a -n "$pb"; test "$(ns $pa net)" != "$(ns $pb net)"; test "$(ns $(sp $a) net)" = "$(ns $pa net)"
test -z "$(podman ps -a -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$a)"; test -z "$(podman ps -a -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$b)"; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1; true
